head.title: Blood Bowl Card Creator
head.description: A client-side web app for creating custom, print-ready Blood Bowl tabletop game cards.

action.remove_border: Remove border to add bleed area for printing
action.preset_notice: These presets reproduce data from official publications. They are intended for users who own the corresponding books and do not replace the official rules.
action.player_preset_source: Third Season profiles grouped by team, cross-checked with BBTC and translated from the verified NRData mapping.

print.title: Print sheets
print.intro: Choose Star Players and arrange them on print-ready A4 sheets, nine cards per page.
print.page_cut_marks: Show cut marks at the edges of the page
print.card_back: Common card back (optional PNG or JPEG)
print.print_hint: In the print dialog, choose A4, 100% scale and no additional margins.
print.empty_preview: Select at least one Star Player to preview the sheets.
print.renderer_timeout: The card renderer did not start. Reload the page and try again.

instructions.title: Blood Bowl Card Creator
instructions.intro: Create, save and print cards for Players, Star Players, Special Plays, card backs and playbooks.
instructions.local_storage: The editor runs directly in your browser. Cards and preferences saved locally remain on your device until you reset them.

preset_warning.title: About official presets
preset_warning.text: Some presets reproduce data from official publications. They are intended for people who own the corresponding books and do not replace the official rules.

editor.title: Create and edit a card
editor.step_1: Choose an editor from the navigation bar: Players, Star Players, Special Cards, Card Back or Plays.
editor.step_2: Fill in the fields or load a preset. The card preview updates as you work.
editor.step_3: Use Save as image to export a PNG, or Save as file to keep an editable JSON card.
editor.step_4: Reload that JSON file later with Load card file. Reset clears locally saved data and restores the defaults.

a4.title: Print nine cards on an A4 sheet
a4.step_1: From any editor, choose Send to print. Star Players can also be selected directly from the Print tab.
a4.step_2: Choose and rearrange up to nine cards per page. You can return to edit a card without losing the selection.
a4.step_3: Enable cut marks, print bleed, dashed borders or square corners as needed.
a4.step_4: Print on A4 paper at 100% scale, with no automatic browser scaling. Check the preview before duplex printing.

professional.title: Professional printing
professional.intro: You can also send the exported card images to a local or online professional printer.
professional.size: Ask for a finished card size of 63 × 88 mm and confirm the required image resolution and colour profile.
professional.bleed: If the printer requires bleed, enable “Remove border to add bleed area for printing” before exporting each card.
professional.marks: Do not add cut marks to individual card files unless the printer specifically requests them.
professional.proof: Order a proof or a small test run before a large order, especially for colour, text size and front/back alignment.
professional.mpc_note: The Noxoffa version listed the following MakePlayingCards settings. They are kept for reference; the project is not affiliated with this company.

gimp.title: Historical GIMP method
gimp.intro: This method remains available if you prefer to compose an A4 page manually:
gimp.step_3: Use File → Open as Layers to add the PNG files, then place them in the nine slots.
gimp.step_4: Set the page margins to 0 and print at 100% scale.

lineage.title: Project versions and lineage
lineage.intro: This project is the result of several successive forks. Each version keeps the previous work and adds its own improvements.
lineage.barry: Created the first Blood Bowl version, adapted from the Warcry card generator.
lineage.graylikeme: Continued the editor and added the Devious skill category.
lineage.turficon: Added card backs, internationalisation, French localisation and other improvements.
lineage.noxoffa: Separated the Player and Star Player editors; added 66 Season 3 Star Player presets, new backgrounds and icons, light/dark themes, four languages and Bootstrap 5.
lineage.dreadaxe: Added nine-card A4 print sheets, a shared print queue for all editors, live card editing, cross-tab persistence, cut marks and border options, Star Player search and French localisation work based on BBTC data.
lineage.summary: Lineage: Barry Sheppard → Graylikeme → Turficon → Noxoffa → Dreadaxe.
